# Natural Earth public-domain data

The Natural Earth land and lake datasets in this directory are in the public domain. Natural Earth permits modification and redistribution for personal, educational, and commercial use without requiring attribution.

Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/

Authoritative terms: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/about/terms-of-use/

Original archive README files and version notices are preserved inside the unchanged ZIP files.
